# Adam James

> Personal site of Adam James — Australian entrepreneur, community builder and writer. Stories on coffee, business, faith, family and the Pay It Forward wheelchair initiative.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Introduction to Adam James and his latest writing.
- [About Adam](/aboutadam): Adam's story, values and work with Cup From Above.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on business, health, coffee, faith and community.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photo gallery of Adam's work and travels.
- [Media & Publications](/media-publications): Press coverage, interviews and features.
- [Paying It Forward](/paying-it-forward): The wheelchair initiative, journal updates and pledge form.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with Adam.
